## 2 Data Model Intake_Case__c custom object (API name provided) with a lookup relationship to Case; record types per channel; field history tracking on status fields. Covers SF-1 routing keys.
## 3 Security and Sharing Model Org-wide default Private; permission set groups per persona; field-level security on member SSN fields; Shield Platform Encryption for data at rest per SF-3; TLS in transit.
## 4 Integration Architecture Named credential to the claims middleware; REST API callouts with platform events for status sync; change data capture feeds the reporting store. Addresses SF-2 console feeds.
## 5 Reporting and Analytics Design CRM Analytics dashboards for SLA compliance per US-4; report types for intake volumes.
